question: Seven people R, S, T, U, V, W and X were sitting around a circular table, facing the centre. They were equidistant to one another. T was sitting to the immediate right of S. W was sitting to the immediate left of V. R and U were immediate neighbours. Only X was sitting between V and S. U was sitting to the immediate right of T. Who was sitting to the immediate left of W?
solution:
Seven people R, S, T, U, V, W and X were sitting around a circular table, facing the centre.

 
• T was sitting to the immediate right of S.
 
• Only X was sitting between V and S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c82ae48b915e80cad24967bae2109cd9c4a4580955d4927334de9775e0036f5c.png] 

 
• W was sitting to the immediate left of V.
 
• R and U were immediate neighbours. 
 
• U was sitting to the immediate right of T. 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0f60a1a5e0c3b09cc2261c0781e142c3d00bb9d54d6aa9299524a55ac10be8eb.png] 

**R **was sitting to the immediate left of W.

Hence, the **correct answer** is** "Option 2".**
